design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 1 (workflow task), difficulty card_billing_payments_and_disputes. Round 2 (rework after policy-task audit round 1: F-1, F-2).

[0] Scope snapshot. Occupied by task 0: card_ext_autopay_miss_late_fee_ground, card_ext_autopay_source_restoration, card_ext_rewards_balance_payoff and their three tools; workflows none. Claimed here: the single workflow card_wf_rewards_card_closure and card_ext_closing_balance_autopay (card_set_autopay), card_ext_closing_points_cashout (card_rewards_redeem, closing cash-out), card_ext_closure_autopay_carryover (card_close), tools refund_closing_annual_fee_cfb04f99, set_closing_card_autopay_dbe1c3a9, cash_out_closing_card_points_6700a44f, confirm_card_closure_806ea607. All six policies are covered and tool sets are disjoint. The closing cash-out and task 0's restoring deposit both post deposit_to_checking redemptions but are different problems (all points into an active checking the cardholder names at closing, versus the points that clear an overdrawn autopay source); each policy names only its own tool.

[1] Why a good test. Surface goal: 'close your Travel Rewards Visa Signature ... today'. The closure policy makes two other problems prerequisites (cash out the points; put a closing autopay in force for the remaining balance) and records the closure by the cardholder's own confirmation (declared overwrite of base card_closure's agent-registered pending request). The SOP opens with the base annual-fee refund (card_evt_annual_fee: fee posted 2026-09-05, closure 2026-09-15, window 30 days) that changes the autopay amount. Scored values: 95.00 bank_error refund (base, computed_by []), autopay fixed_amount 291.82 (13 ledger sums, statement cap 343.02 not binding), 13271 points, option fixed_amount kept on the closed card. Depth: close <- autopay (value), close <- cash-out (gate), and the refund feeding the autopay amount. Breadth: 63 ledger rows at step 8, tier minimum 5000 and cash value 0.01 (travel 0.0125 excluded for deposits), statement cap, checking status read in all three policies.

[2] Problem-tree card. Root card_ext_closure_autopay_carryover. Edge 1 close -> card_ext_closing_points_cashout, state_gate, gate card_transactions.redemption_type, condition 'All of the card's unredeemed points have been cashed out before the closure is confirmed.', policy_source 'the card's unredeemed points must already be cashed out under card_ext_closing_points_cashout, since points are forfeited at closure'; false at open: rewards_balance 13271, no redemption row. Edge 2 close -> card_ext_closing_balance_autopay, value_input, gate option; false: autopay_option none, autopay_source_account_id empty, balance 386.82. The two prerequisites are parallel and independent; resolution order [closing_balance_autopay, closing_points_cashout, closure_autopay_carryover] follows the workflow. Sensitivity (executed): skip step 8 -> closure none (hash 99daede07f634581); skip step 10 -> closure fixed_amount but 13271 points remain on a closed card (hash 63087af926491111); gold hash b14cf3fb7d5bb90b; cash-out swapped before the autopay (or before the refund) -> same gold hash and values. Skip step 6 -> autopay 343.02 (cap binds) instead of 291.82 (hash e9896cc5309eccd1).

[3] Zero-wait causal card. Step 0 refund (agent): fee row 954cba48... and opened_date (initial_state_preexisting), closure request (current_user_input). Step 1 closing autopay (user): balance after refund (prior_synchronous_tool_effect of step 0: the reversal row and current_balance 291.82), last_statement_balance and active Interest Checking (preexisting), consent and account choice (current_user_input). Step 2 cash-out (user): points on the ledger and the active checking (preexisting), cash choice and account (current_user_input); consumes nothing from step 1. Step 3 closure (user): points gone (effect of step 2), autopay in force (effect of step 1, dataflow 1->3 autopay_option); the confirmation itself is the closure record, no pending request. The workflow now also carries requires_external_wait false and a zero_wait_proof.

[4] Workflow step table. S0 refund_closing_annual_fee_cfb04f99 agent card_transactions card_fee_reversal [card_evt_fee_reversal] computed_by [] (gates courtesy_count 0<2, prior_on_time 11>=3, account active, reverse_once evidenced). S1 set_closing_card_autopay_dbe1c3a9 user card_accounts card_set_autopay [card_evt_payments] [card_ext_closing_balance_autopay] -> step 8 autopay_amount. S2 cash_out_closing_card_points_6700a44f user card_transactions card_rewards_redeem [card_evt_rewards] [card_ext_closing_points_cashout] -> step 10 reward_points. S3 confirm_card_closure_806ea607 user card_accounts card_close [card_closure] [card_ext_closure_autopay_carryover] -> step 12 autopay_option.

[5] Base-invariant card and overrides. card_fee_reversal: four card_evt_fee_reversal gates inherited. card_set_autopay: autopay_source - Interest Checking 74012327... active, same customer. card_rewards_redeem: redeem_while_active. card_close: card_closure policy_scope. Refund window: posted 2026-09-05, handled 2026-09-15 (10 days) inside 30; posting 2026-08-16 would be day 30 (still refundable), 2026-08-15 outside. Declared overrides: card_ext_closing_points_cashout supersedes card_evt_rewards 'a deposit to a PCB checking or savings account of the same customer' with 'Outside a closing, points may still be redeemed as a deposit to a PCB checking or savings account of the same customer at rewards_point_value_cash per point; a closing cash-out, however, is made only as a deposit to a PCB checking account of the cardholder whose status is active, the account the cardholder names'; card_ext_closure_autopay_carryover supersedes card_closure 'the agent registers a card_requests row of request_type account_closure in pending_customer_confirmation status, and the account closes only after the cardholder confirms' with 'No separate closure request is registered by the agent: the cardholder's own confirmation on the card account is the closure record, and the account closes at that confirmation and not before'. card_ext_closing_balance_autopay keeps overwrite [] (it respects 'never more than the statement balance').

[6] Business-object card. The annual fee row is the only fee (no earlier fee row: the account opened 2025-09-02 and the 2026-09-05 statement is the first anniversary-month statement more than twelve months after opening); points: 25 earn rows keyed to purchases, no redemptions/forfeits; balance rows: 25 purchases 5279.65, fee 95.00, 11 payments 4987.83 -> 386.82; the September statement (343.02, minimum 98.43 = 1% of 343.02 plus the 95.00 fee billed, due 2026-09-30) is not yet due. One Interest Checking, active.

[7] Persona. Silas, dry and brief; volunteers only the closure and his reason (the 95 fee that just posted); credentials 8045550171 / 1979-11-02 / 7154; reacts to 'points would be lost' with 'cash in your checking'; to 'balance must pay automatically' with agreement and the Interest Checking ending 7730; declines keeping or switching; hangs up after hearing the card is closed.

[8] Standard solution. Reads: customer, verify, card, ledger, checking. KB: closure rule -> needs cash-out and closing autopay; workflow card_wf_rewards_card_closure fixes the SOP. Refund 95.00 bank_error. Autopay: ledger 5374.65 - 5082.83 = 291.82 <= 343.02, active checking -> fixed_amount 291.82 from 74012327.... Cash-out: active checking named by Silas, 13271 >= 5000 -> 13271 points, 132.71. Closure: balance 291.82 > 0, option fixed_amount, source active -> keep fixed_amount. Easy errors: sizing autopay before the refund (343.02) or on 386.82; travel value 165.89; closing with autopay none; closing before the cash-out.

[9] Verification (scratch replay with the real tools; evaluate compute via check_compute.build_env/eval_compute at each handling time): closing_balance_autopay step 8 => 291.82; closing_points_cashout step 10 => 13271; closure_autopay_carryover step 12 => fixed_amount; order with cash-out before autopay => hash b14cf3fb7d5bb90b and the same three values; skip cash-out => 63087af926491111. expected values equal these.

[10] rule<->compute sweep. Autopay: every ledger component has a SUM binding; cap, zero-balance and no-active-checking guards, single final rounding. Cash-out: active_checking/receiver_active = the declared replaced_by sentence and the no-active-checking sentence; ledger count; minimum guard; result = all unredeemed points. Closure: balance/option/source bindings and the three option branches; the new overwrite sentence changes no binding (it governs how the closure is recorded).

[11] Draft recomputation from visible context: same four writes and values; cash-out and autopay commute to the same hash, the workflow fixes one order.

[12] Revision log (round 2). F-1 symptom: the cash-out returned 0 unless the card named an active autopay source, an undeclared narrowing of base card_evt_rewards; root cause: receiving account tied to the autopay instruction with overwrite []. Change: receiving account is an active checking the cardholder names, narrowing to checking declared in overwrite; the cash-out -> closing-autopay prerequisite edge, the 1->2 dataflow and the order_rationale claim were removed; order_uniqueness now states the pair commutes (replay above). F-2 symptom: base card_closure's agent registration of a pending card_requests row was silently dropped; change: declared overwrite in card_ext_closure_autopay_carryover and its rule, workflow scenario states the confirmation is the closure record. Observations addressed: O-4 (effect and order_rationale sentences no longer assume no prior autopay source), O-10 (workflow requires_external_wait/zero_wait_proof), O-T1-c (factor trace no longer claims a 2025-09-05 statement). Re-run: all gates green (see final gate block).

[13] Revision log (round 3, KB audit source-layer notes). N3: the cash-out overwrite's replaced_by now keeps deposits to a PCB checking or savings account as a redemption way outside a closing and narrows only the closing cash-out, so the retired clause no longer contradicts the tiers' rewards_redemption_types. N1: the restoration and cash-out rules and both deposit tools now state that the card policy records the redemption on the card only and posts no entry on the checking account's own ledger (the tools never did). N2: the depended-on policies' rules no longer repeat the ordering their dependants' prerequisites carry ('redeemed first', 'recorded before the closure', 'redeemed before the closure is confirmed'); base card_evt_rewards' own 'must redeem before the closure is confirmed' is frozen base text. N5: the published runbook of card_wf_rewards_card_closure exposes this task's route by design, because the difficulty must declare exactly one workflow and this task must follow it; the scored difficulty stays in the values (291.82 after the refund, 13271, fixed_amount). Values and gold hash unchanged (b14cf3fb7d5bb90b).
user_scenario: You are Silas Pennington, forty-six, a construction project manager in Richmond who used to be on the road every other week and now works almost entirely from home. You are calling Piedmont Crescent Bank on a Tuesday afternoon from your truck, calm and a bit dry, and you get to the point: you want to close your Travel Rewards Visa Signature, the card ending in 6841, today, on this call. You barely travel anymore, and the $95 annual fee that just showed up on your statement is what finally pushed you to do it. You are fine confirming or clicking through anything yourself if the agent sends it to you. You give your mobile number, 8045550171, right away. When the agent wants to verify you, you give your date of birth, 1979-11-02, and the last four of your Social Security number, 7154; if they need one more thing you offer your ZIP code, 23221, or your email, silas.pennington@outlook.com. You know the card still has a balance from last month's groceries and dinners but you could not say how much, and you have no idea how many points are on it; the agent can look those up. If the agent tells you the points would be lost when the card closes, you want them turned into cash in your checking account, not travel or gift cards. If the agent says the balance that is left has to be set to pay automatically before the card can be closed, that suits you fine, and it should come out of your Interest Checking ending 7730, which is the only checking account you have with the bank; you would rather let that automatic payment take care of it than pay it off yourself today. If the agent mentions the annual fee coming off, you say good, that is fair. Whenever the agent hands you something to run or approve, you do it straight away and read out what it says if asked. If the agent asks whether you want to keep the card open after all or switch to a no-fee card, you say no, just close it. When the agent tells you the card is closed, you thank them and hang up; there is nothing else you need.

base_preconditions.condition: Closing is the cardholder's own confirmed decision; a balance does not prevent closure and stays payable, autopay continues until the balance is zero, and unredeemed points are forfeited at closure. card_ext_closure_autopay_carryover declares the overwrite of the agent-registered pending closure request: the cardholder's own confirmation on the card account is the closure record.

edges.condition: All of the card's unredeemed points have been cashed out before the closure is confirmed.
edges.policy_source: the card's unredeemed points must already be cashed out under card_ext_closing_points_cashout, since points are forfeited at closure

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: At 2026-09-15 the card holds 13271 unredeemed points and no redemption row exists.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 10 posts a deposit_to_checking redemption of all 13271 points; rewards_balance becomes 0.

edges.condition: A closing autopay instruction sits on an active checking account before a card that still owes a balance is closed.
edges.policy_source: when a balance will remain owed, a closing autopay instruction under card_ext_closing_balance_autopay must already be in force, so the remaining balance is collected

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The card owes 386.82 and has autopay_option none with no source account, so no closing autopay is in force.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 8 sets autopay_option fixed_amount, autopay_amount 291.82 and the Interest Checking as source; the closure's option binding reads fixed_amount.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The root has two parallel prerequisites, the points cash-out and the closing autopay, and neither reads what the other writes: the cash-out writes a redemption entry and rewards_balance and deposits into the cardholder's active checking whether or not an autopay names it; the closing autopay writes the card's autopay fields and is sized on the balance, which the cash-out does not touch. Replayed with the cash-out (actions 9-10) before the closing autopay (actions 7-8), and also before the refund, the terminal hash is b14cf3fb7d5bb90b, identical to gold, and the three computed values stay 291.82, 13271 and fixed_amount. The workflow fixes autopay-then-cash-out as its one procedure; the scored terminal state does not depend on that pair's order.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping step 10 leaves the closure value fixed_amount but closes the card with 13271 points still on it (terminal hash 63087af926491111 vs gold b14cf3fb7d5bb90b).
Skipping step 8 makes the closure compute none instead of fixed_amount (autopay_option none, no source) - hash 99daede07f634581.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only to close the card. It never asks to cash out points or set up autopay; both appear only as reactions after the agent states them ('If the agent tells you the points would be lost...', 'If the agent says the balance that is left has to be set to pay automatically...'). The 95 annual fee is mentioned only as his reason for closing; he never asks for it back.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: confirm_card_closure_806ea607 only updates status, closed_date and autopay_option; it does not check points or autopay. cash_out_closing_card_points_6700a44f posts whatever points and account it is given; set_closing_card_autopay_dbe1c3a9 overwrites the instruction without checking the account; refund_closing_annual_fee_cfb04f99 posts the reversal it is given (task_tools.py bodies: find card row, ctx.create/ctx.update, return receipt).
